title: Herb Moran, who went to Mexico and died
summary: Vincent recalls Herb Moran, who went to Mexico with the band and later went to New York, and Allen mentions attending his funeral.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Herb Moran. Yeah. Yeah. He went to Mexico with us.
He died too. He died too. He got some of my 50 pounds to give him to me.

And I didn't go, but I didn't make up my mind to go. I told him he died, you know. Yeah, he had to get to him that high. Yeah, stuck up in that high. The best one. When he got back here, he got a job to go to New York. He was a pickler and a flasher. He stayed over there a year in the head. When he come back, he said, He gave me a good time. He told me he had the pictures. About me being kind of busy. He was kind of working through. We used to write to one another. He said, I don't know if he had the senator, but I told him I was coming down to get him. When I made up my mind, I told him he was dead.
I was at his funeral. Yeah. Nobody there much.
You say, wasn't nobody at the funeral much.
